title: Research Methodology
modules: Philosophical And Conceptual Foundations Of Research
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the original data that are collected for the specific research problem at hand."
Primary data is the original data that are collected for the specific research problem at hand.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a qualitative means of ensuring that indicators tap the meaning of a concept as defined by the researcher."
Content validity is a qualitative means of ensuring that indicators tap the meaning of a concept as defined by the researcher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means can be used as measures of central tendency and coefficients of variation may also be calculated."
Geometric and harmonic means can be used as measures of central tendency and coefficients of variation may also be calculated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in order to analyze and visualize the economic problem and relationships between variables."
Model in economics is used in order to analyze and visualize the economic problem and relationships between variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic, replicable process by which variables are quantified and/or classified."
Measurement is the systematic, replicable process by which variables are quantified and/or classified.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a deliberate simplification of reality."
Modeling is a deliberate simplification of reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tentative answer to a research problem that is advanced so that it can be tested."
Development of hypothesis A hypothesis is a tentative answer to a research problem that is advanced so that it can be tested.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ability of a test to predict an event in the present."
Concurrent ability refers to the ability of a test to predict an event in the present.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a representation of data, defining a set of "variables" that are measured on a set of "cases." Like variables, a data set will typically contain multiple cases."
A dataset is a representation of data, defining a set of "variables" that are measured on a set of "cases." Like variables, a data set will typically contain multiple cases.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the phenomenon which exist somewhere and can be verified empirically."
Reality is the phenomenon which exist somewhere and can be verified empirically.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to how well you translated or transformed a concept, idea, or behaviour - that is a construct - into a functioning and operating reality, the operationalisation (Trochim, 2006)."

Construct validity refers to how well you translated or transformed a concept, idea, or behaviour - that is a construct - into a functioning and operating reality, the operationalisation (Trochim, 2006).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the procedure of creating a new data set from an existing data set."
Data manipulation is the procedure of creating a new data set from an existing data set.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in regression analysis to avoid the unreasonable assumption that the original numerical codes for the categories, i.e., the values 1, 2, ..., k, correspond to an interval scale."

Dummy variables are used in regression analysis to avoid the unreasonable assumption that the original numerical codes for the categories, i.e., the values 1, 2, ..., k, correspond to an interval scale.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most famous example of this."
The Anne Frank's diary is the most famous example of this.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in economic process. iii."
Give the reasons why models are used in economic process. iii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a widely used author-date system of referencing or bibliographic citation."
The style is a widely used author-date system of referencing or bibliographic citation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to examine relationships between interval and/or ratio variables."
A correlation matrix is used to examine relationships between interval and/or ratio variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first item read by the supervisor, editor and reviewers for journals."
The title is the first item read by the supervisor, editor and reviewers for journals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the least powerful level of measurement."
Nominal scale is the least powerful level of measurement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a definite plan for obtaining a sample from a given population."
A sample design is a definite plan for obtaining a sample from a given population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the closeness of the findings to "reality" based on a sample."
Precision refers to the closeness of the findings to "reality" based on a sample.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic and scientific investigation of quantitative properties and phenomena and their relationships."
Quantitative Research is the systematic and scientific investigation of quantitative properties and phenomena and their relationships.
fib: ______ is a special type of pooled data in which the same cross-sectional (say a family or firm) is surveyed overtime.
Longitudinal or Micro Panel Data
Longitudinal or Micro Panel Data is a special type of pooled data in which the same cross-sectional (say a family or firm) is surveyed overtime.
______ refers to inferences about whether it is reasonable to presume covariation given a specified alpha level and the obtained variances (Cook & Campbell, 1979).
Statistical conclusion validity
Statistical conclusion validity refers to inferences about whether it is reasonable to presume covariation given a specified alpha level and the obtained variances (Cook & Campbell, 1979).
______ are defined as a characteristic that a researcher manipulate to identify a particular factor.
Independent Variables
Independent variable Independent Variables are defined as a characteristic that a researcher manipulate to identify a particular factor.
______ are used for explaining an economic process, examining an economic issue and developing a new economic theory.
Models in economics
Models in economics are used for explaining an economic process, examining an economic issue and developing a new economic theory.
______ is a subjective judgment on the operationalisation of a construct.
Face validity
Face validity is a subjective judgment on the operationalisation of a construct.
______ is the appropriate measure of central tendency, while standard deviation is the most widely used measure of dispersion.
Mean
Mean is the appropriate measure of central tendency, while standard deviation is the most widely used measure of dispersion.
______ is the sum of the systematic error, which affects the model in a constant fashion, and the random error, which affects the model randomly.
total measurement error
The total measurement error is the sum of the systematic error, which affects the model in a constant fashion, and the random error, which affects the model randomly.
______ is considered as the heart of a survey operation.
Questionnaire
Questionnaire is considered as the heart of a survey operation.
______ is the degree of correspondence between a test measure and one or more external referents (criteria), usually measured by their correlation.
Criterion-related validity
Criterion-related validity is the degree of correspondence between a test measure and one or more external referents (criteria), usually measured by their correlation.
______ are used in economics, some of them show how variables change over time; others show the relationship between different variables.
Numerous kinds of graphs
Numerous kinds of graphs are used in economics, some of them show how variables change over time; others show the relationship between different variables.
______ is a collection of methods for analyzing data in which a number of observations are available for each object.
Multivariate analysis
Multivariate analysis is a collection of methods for analyzing data in which a number of observations are available for each object.
______ is referred to as nominal GDP.
original GDP variable
The original GDP variable is referred to as nominal GDP.
______ are those questionnaires in which there are definite, concrete and pre- determined questions.
Structured questionnaires
Structured questionnaires are those questionnaires in which there are definite, concrete and pre- determined questions.
______ is used to assess and analyze a number of independent variables with the dependent variable linear function of the relationship between the statistical methods.
Multiple regression analysis
Multiple regression analysis is used to assess and analyze a number of independent variables with the dependent variable linear function of the relationship between the statistical methods.
______ are the two most important and fundamental features in the evaluation of any measurement instrument or tool for a good research.
Reliability and validity
Reliability and validity are the two most important and fundamental features in the evaluation of any measurement instrument or tool for a good research.
______ is a formal framework for representing the basic features of a complex system by a few central relationships (Samuelson & Nordhaus, 1998).
model
A model is a formal framework for representing the basic features of a complex system by a few central relationships (Samuelson & Nordhaus, 1998).
______ is an active, dynamic process that inherently must take place over time.
Implicit in a causal vocabulary
Implicit in a causal vocabulary is an active, dynamic process that inherently must take place over time.
______ is a tiny version of the article that extracts the important points.
abstract
Abstract The abstract is a tiny version of the article that extracts the important points.
______ refers to the probability that our estimations are correct.
Confidence
Confidence refers to the probability that our estimations are correct.

Note that simple linear regression
Note that simple linear regression is a special case where k=1, thus the methods used are just basic extensions of what we have previously done.
______ is a construct or concept to which numerical values can be attached.
variable
A variable is a construct or concept to which numerical values can be attached.
